settings.heading: The City's finest wine shop
settings.text: An all-weather tasting terrace on historic St Swithin's Lane, a stone's throw from the Bank of England and Cannon Street.

settings.heading: A destination for wine enthusiasts
settings.text: Welcome to St Swithins Wine Shippers, the City of London's finest wine shop with an all-weather tasting terrace on historic St Swithin's Lane. A destination for wine enthusiasts and connoisseurs alike, with Enomatics and Coravin.

settings.heading: Enomatics
settings.text: 48 wines on taste every weekday from our state-of-the-art Enomatic machines, where you can try a little, or a lot, of a truly diverse array of wines from around the world.

settings.heading: Coravin
settings.text: Rare, and very rare, Grand Cru wines by the glass from our Coravin extractor. Your chance to taste some of the great names and historic vintages.

settings.heading: Tasting terrace
settings.text: Platters and nibbles to match your wine, served all day out on our tasting terrace.

settings.heading: Wine gifts
settings.text: Hundreds of bottles for everyday or special occasions, plus gifts for connoisseurs: Riedel glassware and decanters, wine books, corkscrews, cigars, and Coravin machines.

settings.heading: Food
settings.text: We serve a tempting range of platters and pots on our tasting terrace throughout the day. Each platter is accompanied by our fresh bread selection. Take a table on the all-weather terrace and enjoy a charcuterie board or artisan cheeses to complement wines by the glass or by the bottle.

settings.heading: Inside St Swithins
settings.text: The cellar, the terrace, and the people who make a visit here worth lingering over.
